item.title: Closing arguments in defense of Los Gatos mom Shannon O'Conner expected to begin Monday
item.description: The prosecution wrapped up its second day of closing arguments Friday in the case of Shannon O'Connor, the mom who's on trial for the drunken sex parties involving teens at her home. O'Connor's defense will now have to prove her "not guilty" plea beginning on Monday.

item.title: Actor Eric Dane's unwavering advocacy for ALS was the most powerful role of his career
item.description: Actor Eric Dane's unwavering advocacy for ALS was the most powerful role of his career, and his work will continue to change lives even after his passing.

item.title: How the Japanese locations in 'Rental Family' became more characters in the film
item.description: From city streets to historic restaurants to a unique digital art museum, the locations in "Rental Family" tell even more of the story. The film, starring Brendan Fraser, is streaming now on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

item.title: Gov. Newsom demands refund checks for Americans after SCOTUS strikes down Trump's tariffs
item.description: "These tariffs were nothing more than an illegal cash grab... Every dollar unlawfully taken must be refunded immediately - with interest. Cough up!" Newsom wrote.

item.title: Oakland teachers' union votes to authorize potential strike, citing low wages and high turnover
item.description: On Friday, members of the Oakland teachers' union voted to authorize a potential strike.

item.title: FROM THE ARCHIVE: Oakland's Alysa Liu was making history at 13 and had Olympic dreams
item.description: ABC7 Eyewitness News reporter Lyanne Melendez spoke with Oakland's own newly minted gold medalist Alysa Liu in 2019 when she was just 13, and thinking about her future Olympic dreams.

item.title: Oakland's Bishop O'Dowd HS women's soccer team heads into playoffs with historic season
item.description: "We want to go all the way": Going back to last year, the O'Dowd Dragons are now unbeaten in their last 32 regular season game - rising from relative obscurity just a few years ago to the top team in the North Coast Section.

item.title: Antioch officer shot Food Maxx robbery suspect while trapped inside getaway car: police
item.description: An armed robbery at the Food Maxx in Antioch ended with an officer shooting a suspect while trapped inside the suspect's moving car.

item.title: Castle Peak avalanche victims: Friends, neighbors remember North Bay mom as 'a rockstar'
item.description: We're learning more about the victims of the tragic Tahoe-area ski trip, including a Larkspur mother whose friends say was devoted to her family, career and boutique wine business.

item.title: Castle Peak avalanche: What we know about 6 moms among 9 skiers presumed dead
item.description: Six women killed in the Castle Peak avalanche were among a group of eight close friends and experienced backcountry skiers on a trip together, their families said in a statement Thursday.
